I had a dream of a faraway, southern isle… A thousand miles, maybe just one. Golden sand, I close my eyes, Wake up lost in a strange paradise. Wrapped in white, sunflowers bright, Dark-eyed strangers, staring in light. They take my hand, lead me inside, Cool winds dance where the fabrics glide. Sing me a song, play me a tune, A missing string, still hums in the room. Swaying slow, I hear the past, Echoes of friends I thought wouldn’t last. Fruits so big, colors so new, Birds sing songs the sky never knew. They pour me a drink, sweet and deep, Smile so wide, my soul sinks deep.
